features.title: Shops configuration shell
features.summary: shops-configuration hosts shop, category, product, location, map submodules.
features.content:
## Entry

Navigated from QR owner tools for menu-type QRs. Each child component calls SmartQRApi CRUD endpoints scoped by `qrCodeID` or `shopID`.

features.title: Shops CRUD
features.content:
## Data model

One QR may have multiple shops (e.g. branches). Public endpoints **GetShopsPublic** feed **menu viewer**.

features.title: Categories and products
features.content:
## Catalog

Categories group products per shop. Admin uses **GetMenuProductsForAdmin** for QR-level product overrides in some flows.

features.title: Promotions
features.content:
## Marketing

Promotions attach to QR content and can surface on menu and content viewers.

features.title: Parking zones
features.summary: CreateParkingZone, GetParkingZonesPublic for content QR parking sections.
features.content:
## Parking

Zones are edited in admin and rendered via public getters for end users.

features.title: Menu orders (admin)
features.content:
## Operations

Kitchen or outlet staff update order status; images per line item via **UpdateMenuOrderProductImage**.

features.title: Menu guest tab
features.summary: Guest profiles and tokens for table ordering (GetMenuGuestProfiles).
features.content:
## Guests

**menu-guest-tab** surfaces issued tokens; pairs with **ResolveMenuGuestToken** on scan.

features.title: Public read surface
features.summary: GetShopsPublic, GetProductsPublic mirror owner data without auth.
features.content:
## Security

Must not leak draft or inactive entities — enforce server-side filtering on all `*Public` endpoints.
